topic: How to Evaluate a Small Industrial or Flex Property
caption:
Lesson 19 walks you through a practical, repeatable approach for evaluating small industrial and flex properties in Chester County and Montgomery County, PA. Start with site logistics—access, loading, and parking—then confirm physical fit: ceiling heights, column spacing, doors, and floor loading. Investigate utilities, roof and structural condition, and any environmental or zoning constraints with the local municipality. Build conservative operating expense assumptions and maintain reserves for typical capital items like roofs and HVAC. Consider tenant mix and lease structure when judging income reliability. If you’re evaluating a specific building, I can prepare a concise due-diligence checklist or review a listing with local context. For a tailored review or to submit property details, visit dmsellscre.com/investors and request a walkthrough. Practical, local guidance helps you avoid surprises and make confident investment decisions.
